17:18.text: , We readily grant him what We will for whom We like. Then, afterwards, We have appointed for him Hell; he will burn therein disgraced and rejected

17:19.text: And whoever desires the Hereafter and strives for it, with the necessary effort due for it
(i.e. does righteous deeds of Allâh’s Obedience)
(in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)
- then such are the ones whose striving shall be appreciated,

17:20.text: On each - these as well as those - We bestow from the Bounties of your Lord. And the Bounties of your Lord can never be forbidden.

17:21.text: See how We prefer one above another
, and verily, the Hereafter will be greater in degrees and greater in preferment.

17:22.text: Set not up with Allâh any other ilâh
(This verse is addressed to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم , but its implication is general to all mankind)
, or you will sit down reproved, forsaken

17:23.text: And your Lord has decreed that you worship none but Him. And that you be dutiful to your parents. If one of them or both of them attain old age in your life, say not to them a word of disrespect, nor shout at them but address them in terms of honour.

17:24.text: And lower unto them the wing of submission and humility through mercy, and say: "My Lord! Bestow on them Your Mercy as they did bring me up when I was young."

17:25.text: Your Lord knows best what is in your inner-selves. If you are righteous, then, verily, He is Ever Most Forgiving to those who turn unto Him again and again in obedience, and in repentance.

17:26.text: And give to the kinsman his due and to the Miskîn
and to the wayfarer. But spend not wastefully
in the manner of a spendthrift.

17:27.text: Verily, the spendthrifts are brothers of the Shayâtîn
is ever ungrateful to his Lord.
